id: title:JakeRuth:relay gateway trace ids to sandbox feedback

review.posthog_relevance: Adds trace ID propagation and metadata support for Claude agent sessions, including nonce generation, stderr parsing, and passing trace IDs through session, turn, and rating contexts. This supports potential backend ingestion and correlation, though backend implementation and complete end-to-end benefit are not demonstrated.
